full_judgment: 2. Respondent Nos, 1-3 as plaintiffs filed Title Suit No.30 of 2000 in the Court of Joint District Judge, Second Court, Gaibandha for declaration of title, recovery of khas possession and partition in respect of 127 acres of land as described in schedule-'Ka' to the plaint on the averment, inter alia, that land measuring 131 acres of C.S. khatian No.47 of Moses Zamira under Police Station Palashbari belonged to Jadab Chandra and Madhab Chandra. Jadab' Chandra died leaving behind his son Rajnath Das; Rajnath Das had been possessing 44 acre of land of plot No.194 and 24 acre of land of plot No.657 by way of amicable partition. Rajnath gave pattan of the aforesaid 68 acre of land in favour of Mahendra Das I and Ramchandra Das by a registered Kabuliyat dated 17.04.1952 and the C. S. khatian was prepared in their names. Mahendra Das transferred .40 acre of land from plot No.196 and .22 acre of land from plot No.194 in favour of Abdul Hamid by a registered sale deed dated I 15.04.1996 and handed over the' possession thereof to them. While Madhab Chandra had been possessing 293 acres of land, he gave pattan of 1.78 acres of land by a registered kabuliyat in favour of Ramchandra and Satish Chandra and R.S. khatian No.135 was prepared in their names. Satish Chandra died leaving behind his son Hiralal who purchased 50 acre 'of land from Ramchandra by a registered sale deed being No.5429 dated 06.04.1976. Hiralal transferred .121/4 acre of land in favour of Rabidas @ Abhinash Chandra, Binoy and Sudhir as his. heirs and all of them on 10.07.1996 transferred .65 acre of land in favour of Abdul Hamid and delivered possession of the transferred but land to him and thus, Abdul Hamid had been in possession of said .65 acre of land. Khasra khatian was prepared in the name of Mahendra and Ramchandra, but D.P. Khatian was prepared in the name of Abdul Hamid. Abdul Humid expressed his desire, to sell 1.27 acres of land to which the plaintiffs agreed and accordingly, exe-ruled and registered a bainama on 17.04.2000 and the sale deed was registered   on 15.05.2000. In the month of Srabon of 1407 B.S. when the plaintiffs re went to the suit land for taking possession of the land transferred by the said deed, defendant Nos.l-5 resisted them and I threatened them with dire consequences. Defendant Nos.I-5, being the close relative of Abdul Hamid, wanted to purchase the suit land at a lower price and for this reason, they were trying to create disturbance in the peaceful possession of the plaintiffs in the suit land; hence they filed the suit.
